questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any working should be done in this booklet. The uncertainty in the value of the momentum of a trolley passing between two points X and Y varies with the choice of measuring devices. Measurements for the same trolley made by different instruments were recorded.
mass of trolley using a balance measuring to the nearest g = 6.4 × 10–2kg

questions.questionText: A particle moves in the manner shown by the velocity-time graph. The displacement of the particle has been measured so that it is zero at t = 0. Point Q refers to a point in its motion. Q velocity /ms–1 0 5 10 15 20 time/s –2 Which row of the table is correct? times for maximum acceleration at displacement/s point Q/ms–2
A tennis ball falls freely, in air, from the top of a tall building. Which graph best represents the variation of distance s fallen with time t?

options.C: D s s 0 0 0 t 0 t Space for working

questions.questionText: A small glider moves along a friction-free horizontal air track as shown below. elastic buffer glider air track air At each end of the air track there is a perfectly elastic buffer. Which graph represents the variation with time t of the velocity v of the glider as it moves between the two buffers?

options.C: D v v 0 0 0 t 0 t Space for working

questions.questionText: A force F is applied to a freely moving object. At one instant of time, the object has velocity v and acceleration a. Which quantities must be in the same direction?
The momentum of an object changes from 160kgms–1 to 240kgms–1 in 2s. What is the mean resultant force on the object during the change?
A car accelerates in a straight line.

options.B: the resultant force on the car
options.C: the kinetic energy of the car
options.D: the power supplied to the car Space for working

questions.questionText: The diagram shows a particle P, travelling at speed v, about to collide with a stationary particle Q of the same mass. The collision is perfectly elastic. v P Q Which statement describes the motion of P and of Q immediately after the collision?

options.A: P rebounds with speed 1 v and Q acquires speed 1 v.

questions.questionText: A stone is projected horizontally in a vacuum and moves along the path shown. path of stone H X T V X is a point on this path. XV and XH are vertical and horizontal lines respectively through X. XT is the tangent to the path at X. Along which directions do forces act on the stone at X?

options.A: XV only B XH only C XV and XH D XT only Space for working

questions.questionText: The diagrams all show a pair of equal forces acting on a metre rule. Which diagram shows forces that provide a couple and zero resultant force?

A uniform rod XY of weight 10.0N is freely hinged to a wall at X. It is held horizontal by a force F acting from Y at an angle of 30° to the horizontal, as shown. F wall 60° 30° X Y 10.0N What is the value of F?

options.A: 5.0N B 8.7N C 10.0N D 20.0N Space for working

questions.questionText: The diagram shows two fixed pins, Y and Z. A length of elastic is stretched between Y and Z and around pin X, which is attached to a trolley. Y 50mm X 80 mm P trolley Z 30mm X is at the centre of the elastic and the trolley is to be propelled in the direction P at right angles to YZ. The tension in the elastic is 4N. What is the force accelerating the trolley in the direction P when the trolley is released?
An electric motor produces 120W of useful mechanical output power. The efficiency of the motor is 60%. Which row is correct? electrical power waste heat power input/W output/W

A hammer with 10J of kinetic energy hits a nail and pushes it 5.0mm into a plank. Both the hammer and nail come to rest after the collision. What is the average force that acts on the nail while it moves the 5.0mm?

The diagram shows two vessels, P and Q, both with sides inclined at 45°. vessel P vessel Q Vessel P tapers outwards and vessel Q tapers inwards, as shown. Both vessels contain a liquid. The depth of the liquid in the vessels is the same. The liquid in vessel P is twice as dense as the liquid in vessel Q. pressure due to the liquid on the base of P What is the ratio ? pressure due to the liquid on the base of Q
Two solid substances P and Q have atoms of mass M and M respectively. They have n and n P Q P Q atoms per unit volume. The density of P is greater than the density of Q. What must be correct?

options.C: M n > M n P P Q Q M M
options.D: P> Q n n P Q

options.D: false true false Space for working

questions.questionText: The behaviour of a wire under tensile stress may be described in terms of the Young modulus E of the material of the wire and of the force per unit extension k of the wire. For a wire of length L and cross-sectional area A, what is the relation between E and k?

options.A: E = B E = C E = D E = kL L A kA

questions.questionText: The diagram shows the structure of part of a mattress. spring layer 1 layer 2 The manufacturer wants to design a softer mattress (one which will compress more for the same load). Which change will not have the desired effect?

options.B: using more springs per unit area
options.C: using springs with a smaller spring constant
options.D: using springs made from wire with a smaller Young modulus

questions.questionText: In which order of magnitude are the frequencies of electromagnetic waves in the visible spectrum?

options.A: 1012Hz B 1013Hz C 1014Hz D 1015Hz Space for working

The graph shows the variation with time of displacement for a point on this string. displacement X Y 0 time The separation XY on the graph represents the ……1…… of the wave. X and Y have equal ……2…… . Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?
If a wave can be polarised, it must be

options.D: a transverse wave. Space for working

questions.questionText: In which situation does diffraction occur?

options.A: A wave bounces back from a surface.
options.B: A wave passes from one medium into another.
options.C: A wave passes through an aperture.
options.D: Waves from two identical sources are superposed.

questions.questionText: The diagrams show the arrangement of apparatus for a Young’s slits experiment and also part of the pattern formed on the screen with a ruler placed next to it. screen laser 0.90mm light 5.0m dark 30mm bright 20mm What is the wavelength of the light?

options.A: 4.8 × 10–7m B 5.4 × 10–7m C 3.2 × 10–6m D 3.4 × 10–6m Space for working

questions.questionText: The diagram shows two parallel metal plates connected to a d.c. power supply through a resistor. + – There is a uniform electric field in the region between the plates. Which change would cause a decrease in the strength of the electric field?

options.A: a small increase in the distance between the plates
options.B: a small increase in the potential difference between the plates
options.C: a small increase in the value of the resistor
options.D: a small increase to the area of both plates Space for working

questions.questionText: In each electric field diagram, a positively charged particle is moved from X to Y. In which diagram would the particle experience an increasing repulsive force?
What describes the electric potential difference between two points in a wire that carries a current?

options.A: the force required to move a unit positive charge between the points
options.B: the ratio of the energy dissipated between the points to the current
options.C: the ratio of the power dissipated between the points to the current
options.D: the ratio of the power dissipated between the points to the charge moved Space for working

questions.questionText: A cylindrical piece of a soft, electrically-conducting material has resistance R. It is rolled out so that its length is doubled but its volume stays constant. What is its new resistance? R

A source of electromotive force (e.m.f.) E has a constant internal resistance r and is connected to an external variable resistor of resistance R. As R is increased from a value below r to a value above r, which statement is correct?

options.A: The terminal potential difference remains constant.
options.B: The current in the circuit increases.
options.C: The e.m.f. of the source increases.
options.D: The largest output power is obtained when R reaches r.

options.D: open open closed open closed Space for working
